title: Account security
intro: Protect your account with an authenticator app (two-step verification). Sensitive actions such as reversing a payment, changing roles or changing prices ask for a code from the app.

status.title: Status

standing.protected: Your account is protected and this session is verified.
standing.verifyNow: Your authenticator app is set up. Sensitive actions will ask for a code; you can verify this session now.
standing.enrolNeeded: Your role includes sensitive actions. Set up an authenticator app now so you are not blocked when the company turns the requirement on.
standing.optional: None of your actions needs two-step verification yet, but setting it up protects your account.

status.requiredTitle: Your actions that need a code
status.loadFailed: Could not load your security status. Refresh to try again.

factors.title: Authenticator apps
factors.empty: No authenticator app is set up yet.
factors.removeConfirm: Remove this authenticator app? You will need another one before you can do sensitive actions.
factors.loadFailed: Could not load your authenticator apps. Refresh to try again.

enrol.title: Add an authenticator app
enrol.intro: Use any TOTP authenticator app on your phone (for example Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or 1Password).
enrol.scan: 1. Scan this QR code with your authenticator app.
enrol.qrAlt: QR code to add Honest OS to your authenticator app
enrol.secretLabel: Can't scan it? Enter this key in the app instead:
enrol.codeStep: 2. Enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
enrol.done: Your authenticator app is set up. This session is now verified.

stepUp.title: Confirm it's you
stepUp.body: This action needs a code from your authenticator app.
stepUp.cancelled: This action needs a code from your authenticator app.
stepUp.noFactor: You have not set up an authenticator app yet.

errors.INVALID_CODE: That code is not correct. Check the app and try again.
errors.CODE_EXPIRED: That code expired. Enter the newest code from the app.
errors.NO_FACTOR: You have not set up an authenticator app yet.
errors.FACTOR_NOT_FOUND: That authenticator app no longer exists. Refresh the page.
errors.TOO_MANY_FACTORS: You already have the maximum number of authenticator apps. Remove one first.
errors.NAME_TAKEN: You already use that name for another app. Choose a different name.
errors.TOTP_DISABLED: Authenticator apps are not enabled for this system yet. Ask the administrator.
errors.STEP_UP_FIRST: Verify this session with your authenticator app first.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.VALIDATION: Check the highlighted field and try again.
errors.UNAVAILABLE: The service is unavailable. Check your connection and try again.
